name: BBC-Oxford British Sign Language Dataset (BOBSL)
description: A large-scale video collection of British Sign Language, with annotations supporting sign recognition, sign language alignment, and sign language translation.
citation: Samuel Albanie, Gül Varol, Liliane Momeni, Hannah Bull, Triantafyllos Afouras, Himel Chowdhury, Neil Fox, Bencie Woll, Rob Cooper, Andrew McParland, and Andrew Zisserman. BBC-Oxford British Sign Language Dataset. arXiv:2111.03635, 2021. https://arxiv.org/abs/2111.03635

license.notes: The dataset license is unverified; no dataset license was published in the sources checked.
